source_of_truth.rule: Never label mirror, ACK, canonical, synchronized, or deployed without independent fetch, matching content digest, and receipt.

invariants.notes: Targets, not measured results. No automatic cross-session coordination is established.

cycle: CoLatch input with provenance and authorization
CoReGroup sources and previous receipts; deduplicate
CoGlass inspect contradictions and blind spots
Generate diverse wave candidates across fronts
Choose bounded experiments by information gain
Run permitted tests; HOLD unavailable receivers
One elected receiver handoff with acknowledgment
Recheck at >24h from fresh independent consumer
Evolve, supersede explicitly, or preserve HOLD

wave_policy.goal: High diversity without sacrificing deterministic recoverability
wave_policy.non_repetition: Do not require mathematically impossible global uniqueness; avoid duplicate wave signatures and preserve useful replication and controls.
wave_policy.selection: Novelty is scored alongside evidence gain, accessibility, cost, and falsifiability; novelty alone is not success.

receipt_schema.note: A Git blob SHA is not a SHA-256 receipt. Compute and verify the appropriate digest before populating seed_sha256.

acceptance_tests.T1: All source hashes and permissions independently verified
acceptance_tests.T2: Each wave has a unique signature within an explicit comparison window, or justified replication
acceptance_tests.T3: At least one real receiver independently ingests and acknowledges the Seed
acceptance_tests.T4: A fresh consumer recovers the same Seed and receipts after >24h
acceptance_tests.T5: Unavailable mirror, revoked permission, or mismatch fails closed
acceptance_tests.T6: One elected actuator prevents duplicate effects
acceptance_tests.T7: Zero placeholder claims and no false PASS
acceptance_tests.T8: Human-facing projections satisfy CoWet accessibility and consent-first audio gates

next_action: Implement an independent GitHub-backed consumer that fetches this file and the source manifest, validates typed fields, emits hashed receipt, and rechecks after >24h. Verify website mirrors only after deployed and readable.
